$comment: What each Expo SDK line expects of the packages that move with it. Read by check-sdk-alignment.mjs and check-sdk-trigger.mjs. Version fields ending in a minor ("19.3") are prefixes; full versions are exact. SDK 57 is the verified set (2026-09-26). SDK 58 comes from expo 58.0.0-preview.7 and the Expo versions API, read on 2026-09-28: confirm every value against the stable release (node_modules/expo/bundledNativeModules.json and the versions API) and update this file in the same commit as the move. A new SDK (59 and later) needs its own entry before check-sdk-alignment.mjs accepts it.

58.status: preview on 2026-09-28 (58.0.0-preview.7, React Native 0.88.0-rc.1); beta since 2026-09-15; stable expected mid or late October 2026

jestConfigMustInclude.why: Reanimated 4.7 and Worklets 0.13 load their native initializers under Jest without it ('[Reanimated] setCSSEventHandler is not available in JSReanimated'); the resolver picks the web implementations (Reanimated's testing guide)
jestConfigMustInclude.fix: Add resolver: 'react-native-reanimated/jest/resolver' to SHARED in jest.config.js (every project).

jestConfigMustInclude.why: jest-expo 58 maps react-native/asset-registry to react-native/src/asset-registry, which React Native 0.88's exports map hides from that resolver ('Could not locate module react-native/asset-registry mapped as react-native/src/asset-registry')
jestConfigMustInclude.fix: Add '^react-native/asset-registry$': '<rootDir>/node_modules/react-native/src/asset-registry.js' as the first entry of WORKSPACE_MODULES in jest.config.js.

removedReactNativeApis.fix: Split the long task into smaller ones and schedule them with requestIdleCallback (React Native 0.88 throws 'InteractionManager has been removed from react-native core' in development).
Use animationType ("none" | "slide" | "fade"); React Native 0.88's Modal has no animated prop.
Remove it; React Native 0.88's StatusBar has no backgroundColor (edge to edge: colour the view behind the bar).
Remove it; React Native 0.88's StatusBar has no translucent (edge to edge is the only mode; safe-area insets place content).
